message.content:
This document is a technical README/manual for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. Key technical points:

**Architecture & Models**
- Supports GLM-5.3-Flash (320B params, 18B active, 3:1 linear/sparse attention hybrid, mHC residuals, MTP), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and MiniMax-M3.1-F
